brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors. Doctor correctly prioritized the suspected ingestion, screened for red flags, obtained substance details, advised stopping uncertain administration, distinguished tests from medications, gave layered action plan with safety-net, and obtained caregiver read-back. Two high-order points were meaningfully completed: navigating real-world constraints (HO4) and correcting the medication/test confusion with executable categorization (HO1).
